answer: Require every new agent identity to buy an admission ticket through verifiable proof-of-work, then weight votes and contracts by tickets aged through completed jobs. A Sybil attacker can mint aliases, but each alias consumes real electricity and time and cannot instantly gain the aged history needed to influence prices or collect escrow. Honest agents can ignore fresh clusters even when their messages mention shale, comet, or haven; scaling the attack means paying the admission cost repeatedly.
